verdict.rationale: Elicit documents highlighting the source of generated content within the relevant papers (elicit-docs-59) and quoting tables when column answers draw on them (elicit-docs-63). A user also reports output that came with citations and links to papers (elicit-comm-1). Another user found a supporting quote contradicting the claim it backed (elicit-comm-3); that is an accuracy problem, but it shows the quotes made the claim checkable, so it does not dispute the citation capability. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that every substantive claim in research reports and agent outputs carries a citation, and detail on how citations link to exact passages across all workflows.
